title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) will practice Friday
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten (ankle/foot) will practice for the first time this week on Friday.
items.impact: Tuten has been dealing with ankle and foot issues going back to last week. He ended up playing last Thursday against the Ravens, going for 29 yards and a score on 12 carries. Tuten seems likely to play against the Titans on Sunday too,  but his workload could be limited once again.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jessie Bates III will not play in Week 10
items.desc: Jessie Bates III will not make his debut for the Jaguars in Week 10.
items.impact: Bates was acquired from the Falcons before having a bye week. The Jaguars will give their new safety a chance to get more acquainted with the playbook and rest up for the long haul.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jordan Davis will not debut for Jaguars in Week 10
items.desc: Jordan Davis will not play for the Jaguars in Week 10.
items.impact: Acquired via trade with the Eagles earlier this week, Davis will be given more time to prepare for his debut with the Jaguars. Davis has not had a bye week yet this season, but the Jaguars have had theirs. Arik Armstead and Ruke Orhorhoro will hold down the interior of the defensive line against the Titans.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) not expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Chris Bell (knee) has been listed as doubtful for Sunday's game at Indianapolis.
items.impact: Bell is dealing with a knee issue, and head coach Jeff Hafley said the rookie receiver is doubtful for Sunday. Fellow rookie Kevin Coleman should see an uptick in snaps.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: C.J. Henderson agrees to extension with Falcons
items.desc: C.J. Henderson has inked a two-year contract extension with the Falcons.
items.impact: Henderson is in his second season with the Falcons, and it looks like he will be around for at least two more. The veteran corner, a first-round pick back in 2020, has played in eight games so far this season, totaling 41 tackles, nine passes defended, and a fumble recovery.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Lamar Jackson (thumb) undergoes surgery, out 6-10 weeks
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (thumb) will miss 6-10 weeks after undergoing thumb surgery.
items.impact: Jackson seems likely to miss the rest of the season while rehabbing from thumb surgery this week. However, that is not definite, as head coach Jesse Minter stated that the "timelines are challenging to predict." The Ravens traded for veteran QB Jacoby Brissett last week, and he's expected to helm the Ravens' offense starting Monday night against the Chargers.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Cameron Thomas inks extension with Falcons
items.desc: Cameron Thomas agrees to a three-year extension with the Falcons.
items.impact: Thomas signed a one-year, free-agent pact with the Falcons back in March. The fifth-year pro, originally a third-round selection of the Cardinals in 2022, has registered 25 total tackles, 2.0 sacks, and a forced fumble through nine games with the Falcons. Thomas' new deal is worth up to $33 million over the three years.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Giants D/ST allows 24 points in TNF loss
items.desc: The Giants D/ST allowed 24 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
items.impact: New York's defense struggled to contain the Commanders' passing attack as they allowed two long touchdown catches in the game. They did manage to intercept Jayden Daniels twice in the contest while getting a sack from Shelby Harris. The Giants will have a tough test in Week 11 against an excellent Jacksonville offense.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Dominic Zvada makes three XPs in Week 10 loss
items.desc: Dominic Zvada missed his lone field-goal attempt but added three extra points in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
items.impact: Zvada missed on a 33-yard attempt in the first quarter. The rookie kicker has made 17 of his 23 field-goal attempts while converting all 16 of his extra points this season. He will take on the Jaguars in Week 11.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Isaiah Likely explodes for 127 yards, one TD in Week 10
items.desc: Isaiah Likely caught nine of his 11 targets for 127 yards and one touchdown in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
items.impact: Likely turned in a huge outing in the loss to Washington on Thursday night. He did most of his damage on a 66-yard TD catch from J.J. McCarthy in the fourth quarter. Likely's impressive first season with the Giants continues as he now has 55 catches for 575 yards and seven touchdowns in nine games. He will be a locked-in TE1 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Darnell Mooney held to eight yards in Week 10
items.desc: Darnell Mooney caught two of his five targets for eight yards in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: Mooney led the Giants in receiving in Week 9 but he couldn't keep it going in the Thursday night loss. The veteran wideout has just 14 catches for 175 yards in nine games for New York this year. He will not be a recommended fantasy option in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Malachi Fields goes for 62 yards in Week 10
items.desc: Malachi Fields caught three of his four targets for 62 yards in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: Fields finished second on the Giants in receiving in the close loss. The rookie wideout has emerged as a solid big-play threat for the Giants this year, averaging 15.9 yards per catch. Overall, he has 22 catches for 350 yards and one touchdown in nine games. He will be a boom/bust flex option in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Malik Nabers catches five balls in Week 10 loss
items.desc: Malik Nabers caught five of his seven targets for 44 yards on Thursday night in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
items.impact: Nabers finished second on the team in targets and catches, but it was a second straight pedestrian outing for the star wideout. He now has 58 catches for 692 yards and two touchdowns in nine games this season. He will be a low-end WR1 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Devin Singletary sees just one carry in TNF loss
items.desc: Devin Singletary carried the ball once for three yards in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: Singletary was quiet with Cam Skattebo returning from a one-game absence and dominating the backfield touches for New York. Singletary can head back to the waiver wire in fantasy leagues ahead of a Week 11 matchup against the Jaguars.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Cam Skattebo scores two TDs in Week 10
items.desc: Cam Skattebo carried the ball 18 times for 78 yards and two touchdowns while catching three of his four targets for 44 yards on Thursday night in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10.
items.impact: Skattebo missed the previous game with a hamstring injury but he was a difference-maker for the Giants in Week 10. The second-year runner found on the end zone twice, on runs of one and 13 yards. Skattebo has run for 496 yards and four touchdowns while catching 14 passes for 120 yards in eight games this year. He will be an RB2 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Jaguars.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: J.J. McCarthy throws one TD in Week 10 loss
items.desc: J.J. McCarthy completed 23 of his 36 passes for 293 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while adding 34 rushing yards on six carries in a 24-21 loss to the Commanders in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: McCarthy dealt with a hip pointer throughout the week, but it didn't seem to be an issue for him in the loss on Thursday night. The veteran signal-caller found Isaiah Likely for a 66-yard touchdown catch in the fourth quarter to give the Giants a temporary lead. McCarthy has thrown for 915 yards, two touchdowns, and two interceptions in five games for the Giants this year. He will be a solid QB2 in a tough matchup against the Jaguars in Week 11.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Commanders D/ST allows 21 points in TNF win
items.desc: The Commanders D/ST allowed 21 points while notching one sack and forcing two turnovers in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: Washington's defense struggled to contain Cam Skattebo, who ran for two touchdowns, but they otherwise did a decent job limiting the Giants. They will have a much tougher test on their hands in Week 11 when they face off against a red-hot Bengals offense.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Drew Stevens makes one FG in Week 10 win
items.desc: Drew Stevens made a 46-yard field goal and added three extra points in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: Stevens was perfect on the night, giving him 17 made field goals on 20 attempts this season. The rookie kicker will now prepare to take on the Bengals in Week 11.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Ben Sinnott finds the end zone in Week 10 win
items.desc: Ben Sinnott caught all four of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday game.
items.impact: Sinnott caught his first touchdown of the season while finishing second on the team in receiving yards in the close win. He saw some extra chances as Chig Okonkwo briefly left the game to get a back injury checked out. Sinnott is unlikely to be a fantasy option for as long as Okonkwo is healthy. He will face off against the Bengals in Week 11.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Chig Okonkwo catches four passes in TNF win
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo caught four of his eight targets for 24 yards in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: Okonkwo finished second on the team in targets despite missing some time during the game with a back issue. He was able to return to the game after getting the injury checked out, but fellow tight end Ben Sinnott caught a touchdown pass during his absence. Okonkwo now has 27 catches for 263 yards through seven contests. He will look for his first TD of the season in Week 11 vs. the Cincinnati Bengals.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Treylon Burks catches two passes in Week 10 win
items.desc: Treylon Burks caught two of his three targets for 27 yards in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: Burks returned from a one-game absence due to a foot injury but he wasn't a big part of the passing attack in the close win over the Giants. Burks now has 14 catches for 260 yards and two touchdowns through seven games for the Commanders this season. He will be a low-end flex option in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Antonio Williams scores TD in Week 10 win
items.desc: Antonio Williams caught both of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: Williams hauled in a 31-yard touchdown pass from Jayden Daniels in the third quarter. Unfortunately, he only drew two targets on a night when Daniels spread the ball around. Williams has shown explosive play-making potential in his rookie year, but he will need more targets to be fully trustworthy in fantasy leagues. Williams will be a boom/bust flex option in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Stefon Diggs goes for 83 yards, TD in Week 10
items.desc: Stefon Diggs caught six of his 10 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10.
items.impact: Diggs had his best game of the season in the close win over the Giants on Thursday night. The veteran wideout caught the game-winning touchdown on a 32-yard pass from Jayden Daniels with 57 seconds left in regulation. Diggs has shown a nose for the end zone in his first season in Washington, catching six touchdowns in eight games. He will be a fantasy WR3 in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Austin Ekeler sees 13 touches in Week 10
items.desc: Austin Ekeler carried the ball nine times for 26 yards and caught all four of his targets for 26 yards in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: Ekeler saw his largest touch total of the season while Rachaad White had 12 touches. The veteran running back has yet to find the end zone through six games this year, but he is worth a look as a low-end flex in deeper leagues moving forward. The Commanders face the Bengals in Week 11.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Rachaad White runs for 47 yards in Week 10 win
items.desc: Rachaad White carried the ball 11 times for 47 yards and caught one of his two targets for a five-yard gain in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: White averaged a solid 4.3 yards per carry but was unable to do much damage in the passing game. Meanwhile, Austin Ekeler cut into his workload more than usual as he logged his highest touch total of the season, with 13. With 409 all-purpose yards and three TDs this season, White will be a flex option in fantasy in Week 11 against the Bengals.

items.author: Matthew Adam
items.title: Jayden Daniels throws three TDs in TNF win
items.desc: Jayden Daniels completed 23 of his 33 passes for 249 yards, three touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding 28 rushing yards on 11 carries in a 24-21 win over the Giants in Week 10's Thursday night game.
items.impact: Daniels wasn't his sharpest, throwing his first two interceptions of the season, but he got the job done. He threw two long touchdowns in the game, including a game-winning 32-yard TD toss to Stefon Diggs with 57 seconds left in regulation. Daniels now has 1,499 passing yards, 10 touchdowns, and two interceptions through seven games this year. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 11 vs. the Bengals.
